items.html:
CLI archives built from the Studio release studio-v2.40.0.

This release fixes the unclickable workspace "+" button, adds a turn-narration setting, and lets the changelog switch between Chinese and English.

New

  • The feedback dialog gains "Capture this window": it takes one picture of the app window only when you click, adds it as a removable thumbnail, and never sends it on its own. Refs #11965.
  • The session tree now carries each conversation's last-activity time, so a list can sort by recency or show a relative time. Refs #12011.
  • A sub-agent queued behind another's write claim now says whose claim it waits on, and whether neither declared write_paths (each treated as writing the whole workspace). Refs #12052.
  • Theme packs gain shadowFloat, the shadow menus, popovers and dialogs cast; unset keeps the built-in one. Refs #12063.
  • Charts now write each value beside its bar or line point while the plot is sparse, and draw none when there are too many marks to read; hover readout is unchanged. Refs #12291.
  • Projects in the sidebar can now be reordered by dragging a row; a line on the target's top or bottom edge shows where it lands, and the order is kept by the kernel. Refs #12300.
  • The "Worked for" line at the end of a turn now also says when the turn began (time of day for today, with the date for another day), and it survives reopening the session. Refs #12728.
  • Settings > Account gains "Export and import config": no account needed; export an encrypted file and import it item by item elsewhere. Keys off by default; a passphrase is required. Refs #12736.
  • Settings → Session gains "Narration between tool calls": Detailed asks the model for three or four lines between batches of tool calls; Brief, the default, changes nothing. Refs #12788.
  • The project menu gains "Open with …": besides the file manager, open a project folder in the VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ IDEA or system terminal this machine has installed. Refs #12858.
  • The workbench explorer gains a "Commit history" section: opened, it lists the newest commits of every branch as a graph, with branches and tags. Refs #12913.
  • Settings → Appearance gains a "Sessions from 1.x" switch to hide migrated 1.x sessions from the sidebar; shown by default, nothing is deleted. Refs #12964.
  • In the terminal UI, /theme now opens a picker that previews each row as you move, keeps it on Enter and restores the original on Esc; /theme list still prints the names. Refs #12985.
  • When the context is over the compaction threshold with nothing to fold, a notice now says what holds the tokens, by class and largest items. Refs #13013.
  • Local stdio MCP servers now receive the extra folders you allowed tools to write in _meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]; remote ones do not. Refs #13053.
  • First-run setup gains "Not now": open the workbench first, with a note above the input box leading back to setup; this launch only, offered again next time. Refs #13065.
  • The bottom "Generation speed" detail gains "Time to first token" (request sent to first output, timed by the kernel) and now uses the same row layout as the context detail. Refs #13075.
  • Adding a project now selects it and opens a new session in it (nothing is sent for you), whether through "Open or create project", the first-run prompt or a folder drop. Refs #13076.
  • New floating "Back to top" / "Jump to latest" buttons in the conversation (hidden near an end or when nothing scrolls) land on the nearest expanded block first. Refs #13077.
  • The Versions page can switch a release's notes between Chinese and English, following the interface language by default; every release's notes now carry English. Refs #13081.

Changed

  • The Files button in the rail and sidebar now toggles: pressed while the files panel is open it folds it, and it reopens after the panel was closed elsewhere. Refs #12925.
  • The composer's model menu now sets provider headings apart, indents the models, and adds multi-select provider chips that are remembered. Refs #12926.
  • Restore the black-and-gold application, taskbar/Dock, launcher and tray icons. Refs #13004.
  • Sent pictures, pictures waiting in the composer and tool screenshots share one viewer: open the original, Esc to leave, focus returns. Refs #13006, #13010.
  • The Settings sidebar's selected row no longer carries the accent colour, outline and edge bar, only a deeper fill; section titles are lighter than the items under them. Refs #13045, #13046.
  • The title-bar Browser button is gone: the Workbench tab is the one way in, and with nothing running it shows the Files / Changes / Browser start page instead of opening a blank page. Refs #13067.
  • Session rows no longer show the hover Archive and Delete icons; both stay in the right-click menu, and the Delete key still works. Refs #13068.

Fixed

  • When the model cannot draft a commit message, the commit card still lists the staged files and says why; type the message and commit. Refs #12747.
  • The context gauge now reads the provider's reported size plus what grew since, instead of the larger of that and the local estimate, so an estimate running high no longer inflates it. Refs #12988.
  • A read-only find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ... is no longer treated as a write, so it does not claim the workspace write lease or collide with another session's edit. Refs #12993.
  • The repeated-output guard now also flags a stream that collapses to a few tiny lines in no fixed order; before it only saw byte-identical loops. Refs #13001.
  • Each sub-agent in the sub-agents popover now shows its own task title (the first line of its description, cut to fit, full text on hover), so parallel ones no longer all read "task". Refs #13002.
  • Switching to a long session no longer shows "could not restore extension surfaces"; you hear once only if a surface was dropped. Refs #13011.
  • On the run-analysis signal rail, marks too close together now share one counted marker that opens a list, instead of stacking into a tall column. Refs #13034.
  • Fixed the project row's "…" button answering only at its corners: the faded count badge kept sitting over it and taking the click; it no longer takes the pointer. Refs #13036, #13038.
  • The magnifier beside the session filters is now a real toggle: pressing it again closes the find box instead of replaying its opening animation. Refs #13041.
  • The "+" that opens or creates a project folder on the sidebar's "This machine" row is now always visible instead of appearing only when the row is hovered. Refs #13043, #13072.
  • Fixed the branch hover card staying on screen under the branch menu and stacking a second shadow. Refs #13044.
  • The red notice raised when reading the session status fails on reload now clears itself when that read next succeeds, instead of waiting for "Got it". Refs #13047.
  • Failures that do not block sending now show as corner notices (three at most, dismissed only by you) with "Report this problem". Refs #13047, #13048.
  • The extension-surface, MCP catalog and changed-files reads treat a missing list as empty instead of raising "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')". Refs #13055.
  • The branch list, event replay and queue now answer an empty list instead of null when they are empty, so the page no longer fails reading them. Refs #13055.
  • The "Report this problem" entry on error bars and corner notices now also writes a page defect's error name and where it came from (file name and line only) into the feedback draft. Refs #13055.
  • A red notice under the composer that comes from a defect of the page itself (for example "Cannot read properties of undefined") now also logs its stack to the console. Refs #13055.
  • Uploading a large image or file from the phone remote page no longer drops the connection: an oversized request is refused on the phone with a clear message and the link keeps working. Refs #13056.
  • The phone remote page can now upload larger images and files, sent as several messages and handled once the desktop has them all (up to 16 MB). Refs #13056.
  • Fixed the repeated "Checkpoint recording failed" warning for writes outside the workspace, such as the session temp folder: they are now a coverage gap, not a failure. Refs #13060.
  • Fixed the kernel crashing when an MCP server fails to launch or reconnect: a failed server now only becomes unavailable, nothing else is affected. Refs #13086.

items.html:
本版本修复工作区「+」无法点击等问题，新增回合叙述设置，并让更新日志支持中英文切换。

新增

  • 反馈对话框新增「截取当前窗口」：只在你点按钮时截一次，截图以可删除的缩略图加入附件，不会自动发送。关联 #11965 fixed in #13033。
  • 侧边栏的会话列表数据现在带「最后活动时间」，可按最近使用排序或显示相对时间。关联 #12011 fixed in #12995。
  • 子代理因另一个子代理占着要写的路径而排队时，现在会说明在等谁、是否因为双方都没声明 write_paths（按整个工作区处理）。关联 #12052。
  • 主题包新增 shadowFloat，可改菜单、弹出层和对话框的投影；不设则保持内置阴影。关联 #12063 fixed in #12996。
  • 图表在数据不多时，会在柱顶和折线数据点旁直接标出数值；数据多到放不下时自动不画，悬停读数仍然可用。关联 #12291。
  • 侧栏里的项目现在可以拖动排序：按住项目行拖到目标位置，上沿或下沿的线指示落点；顺序保存在内核里。关联 #12300。
  • 每轮结束时的「耗时」行现在同时写出这一轮的开始时间（当天只显示时分，其他日子带日期），重新载入会话后仍然保留。关联 #12728 fixed in #12994。
  • 设置 > 账号新增「导出与导入配置」：无需账号，加密导出成文件、换机器时逐项导入；密钥默认不导出，必须设口令。关联 #12736。
  • 设置 → 会话新增「回合间叙述」：选「详细」后，模型会在每批工具调用之间用三四行说明拿到了什么、下一步做什么；默认「简短」，行为不变。关联 #12788 fixed in #13101。
  • 项目右键菜单新增「用 … 打开」：文件管理器之外，可用本机已安装的 VS Code、Cursor、IntelliJ IDEA、系统终端打开项目文件夹。关联 #12858。
  • 工作台文件面板里新增「提交历史」：展开后按提交图谱列出所有分支最近的提交，带分支和标签。关联 #12913 fixed in #13028。
  • 设置 → 外观新增「1.x 旧会话」开关，可把迁移来的 1.x 会话从侧栏隐藏；默认显示，不删除，搜索和已打开的不受影响。关联 #12964 fixed in #13097。
  • 终端界面的 /theme 现在打开选择器：光标移到哪一行就即时预览，Enter 保留，Esc 还原；/theme list 仍列出名称。关联 #12985 fixed in #12999。
  • 上下文超过压缩阈值而无内容可折叠时，现在会说明由什么占用（按类别和最大几项），不再只说「无需压缩」。关联 #13013。
  • 本机 stdio MCP 服务器现在会在 _meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"] 里收到你额外允许写入的目录；远程服务器不会收到。关联 #13053。
  • 首次启动的设置页新增「稍后再说」：可先进入主界面，输入框上方会提示「去连接」；只对本次启动有效，下次仍会提示。关联 #13065 fixed in #13084。
  • 底部「生成速度」详情新增「首字时间」（从发出请求到首个输出，由内核计时），并改为与「上下文详情」一致的行式样式。关联 #13075 fixed in #13089。
  • 添加项目后会自动选中该项目并打开一个新会话（不会替你发送任何消息），无论是点「打开或新建项目」、首次提示里的按钮还是拖入文件夹。关联 #13076 fixed in #13088。
  • 对话区右下角新增「回到顶部 / 跳到最新」悬浮按钮（距端不足 48px 或无需滚动时隐藏），优先跳到最近的展开块，取代原「回到最新」。关联 #13077 fixed in #13091。
  • 版本页的更新内容可以在中文和英文之间切换，默认跟随界面语言；之后每个版本的发布说明都附带英文。关联 #13081。

变更

  • 左侧图标栏和侧栏的「文件」按钮现在是开关：文件面板已展开时再点一次就收起，在别处关掉后再点会重新展开。关联 #12925 fixed in #12997。
  • 撰写框的模型菜单里，服务商标题更醒目、模型行缩进，并新增按服务商的筛选标签（可多选、可清除，选择会记住）。关联 #12926。
  • 应用、任务栏/Dock、启动器和托盘图标恢复为黑金配色。关联 #13004 by @SivanCola。
  • 对话里的图片、输入框里待发的图片和工具截图共用一个查看器：点击放大原图，Esc 退出，焦点回到缩略图。关联 #13006 fixed in #13022、#13010 fixed in #13022。
  • 设置侧栏的选中项不再带强调色、边框和左侧竖条，只是底色变深；分区标题比选项更轻，层级更清楚。关联 #13045 fixed in #13050、#13046 fixed in #13050。
  • 去掉顶栏的「浏览器」按钮：「工作台」标签是唯一入口，没有运行中的网页时显示「文件 / 改动 / 浏览器」启动页，不再直接开一个空白页。关联 #13067 fixed in #13095。
  • 会话行不再在悬停时显示「归档」「删除」两个小图标，界面更简洁；这两个操作仍在右键菜单里，Delete 键也照常可用。关联 #13068 fixed in #13079。

修复

  • 模型起草提交说明失败时，提交卡片仍列出暂存的文件，输入框留空并说明原因，可以手动填写后提交。关联 #12747 fixed in #12923 and #13005。
  • 上下文用量改为以服务商回报的大小加上之后新增的内容为准，不再取本地估算和回报中较大的一个，估算偏大时不再虚高。关联 #12988 fixed in #12991 and #13018。
  • 只读的 find ... -exec wc/grep/cat/stat ... 不再被当成写入：它不会占用工作区写入租约，也就不会再和另一个会话正在写的文件冲突。关联 #12993 fixed in #13003。
  • 模型退化成「很多句不重复的短句」（如 go. / End. / I wait.）时，重复输出检测现在也会提示；以前只认字节完全相同的循环。关联 #13001 fixed in #13008。
  • 子代理浮层里每个子代理现在显示自己的任务标题（来自任务描述的首行，过长截断，悬停看全文），并行的子代理不再都只写「task」。关联 #13002 fixed in #13014。
  • 切换长会话时不再弹出「扩展界面恢复失败」；只有确实丢了扩展界面才提示一次，读不出历史才报错。关联 #13011 fixed in #13019。
  • 运行分析的信号轨里挨得太近的标记合并成一个带数量的标记，点开列出明细，不再排成很长的竖列。关联 #13034 fixed in #13040。
  • 修复项目行上“…”按钮只有四个角能点、点中间没有反应的问题：行内的数量徽标淡出后仍然盖在按钮上，现在不再拦截鼠标。关联 #13036 fixed in #13042、#13038。
  • 侧栏会话筛选旁的放大镜现在是真正的开关：再点一次会收起搜索框，不再重播弹出动画。关联 #13041 fixed in #13049。
  • 侧栏「这台机器」行上打开或新建项目文件夹的“＋”按钮现在始终可见，不再要把鼠标移到行上才出现。关联 #13043 fixed in #13074、#13072。
  • 修复输入框里打开分支菜单时，悬停提示卡没有收起、与菜单叠成两层阴影的问题。关联 #13044 fixed in #13054。
  • 重新载入会话时读取状态失败而弹出的红色提示，在之后同一读取成功时会自动消失，不用再手动点“知道了”。关联 #13047。
  • 设置没生效、链接打不开等不阻断发送的失败，改为右下角的小提示（最多 3 条，点“知道了”才消失），可一键“报告此问题”。关联 #13047、#13048。
  • 扩展界面、MCP 目录和改动文件三处读取遇到缺失的列表字段时按空列表处理，不再弹出「Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')」。关联 #13055。
  • 分支列表、事件回放和待发队列在为空时现在返回空列表而不是 null，页面不再因此在读取时出错。关联 #13055。
  • 报错条与右下角提示的「报告此问题」现在会把页面自身错误的名称和出错位置（仅文件名与行列号）一并填进反馈草稿，便于定位。关联 #13055。
  • 输入框下的红色提示若是页面自身的程序错误（如“Cannot read properties of undefined”），现在会把调用栈写进控制台，便于定位。关联 #13055。
  • 手机远控页上传较大的图片或文件时，不再把连接弄断：过大的内容会在手机上直接提示并留在原处，其他操作照常。关联 #13056。
  • 手机远控页现在可以上传较大的图片和文件：内容拆成多条消息发送，电脑端收齐后一次处理（最大 16 MB）；旧版电脑端仍提示太大。关联 #13056。
  • 修复写入会话临时目录等工作区外位置时反复弹出“检查点记录失败”的提示：这类写入不在检查点范围内，改为记为覆盖缺口。关联 #13060 fixed in #13063。
  • 修复 MCP 服务器启动或重连失败时内核崩溃退出的问题：失败现在只会让这个服务器不可用，不会影响其他功能。关联 #13086 fixed in #13090。
  • 修复部分 Windows 电脑上界面图片（如左上角字标）显示为破损图片的一个可能原因：页面文件的类型不再受注册表里别的程序设置的影响。关联 #13094。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

This release fixes the unclickable workspace "+" button, adds a turn-narration setting, and lets the changelog switch between Chinese and English.

New

  • The feedback dialog gains "Capture this window": it takes one picture of the app window only when you click, adds it as a removable thumbnail, and never sends it on its own. Refs #11965 fixed in #13033.
  • The session tree now carries each conversation's last-activity time, so a list can sort by recency or show a relative time. Refs #12011 fixed in #12995.
  • A sub-agent queued behind another's write claim now says whose claim it waits on, and whether neither declared write_paths (each treated as writing the whole workspace). Refs #12052.
  • Theme packs gain shadowFloat, the shadow menus, popovers and dialogs cast; unset keeps the built-in one. Refs #12063 fixed in #12996.
  • Charts now write each value beside its bar or line point while the plot is sparse, and draw none when there are too many marks to read; hover readout is unchanged. Refs #12291.
  • Projects in the sidebar can now be reordered by dragging a row; a line on the target's top or bottom edge shows where it lands, and the order is kept by the kernel. Refs #12300.
  • The "Worked for" line at the end of a turn now also says when the turn began (time of day for today, with the date for another day), and it survives reopening the session. Refs #12728 fixed in #12994.
  • Settings > Account gains "Export and import config": no account needed; export an encrypted file and import it item by item elsewhere. Keys off by default; a passphrase is required. Refs #12736.
  • Settings → Session gains "Narration between tool calls": Detailed asks the model for three or four lines between batches of tool calls; Brief, the default, changes nothing. Refs #12788 fixed in #13101.
  • The project menu gains "Open with …": besides the file manager, open a project folder in the VS Code, Cursor, IntelliJ IDEA or system terminal this machine has installed. Refs #12858.
  • The workbench explorer gains a "Commit history" section: opened, it lists the newest commits of every branch as a graph, with branches and tags. Refs #12913 fixed in #13028.
  • Settings → Appearance gains a "Sessions from 1.x" switch to hide migrated 1.x sessions from the sidebar; shown by default, nothing is deleted. Refs #12964 fixed in #13097.
  • In the terminal UI, /theme now opens a picker that previews each row as you move, keeps it on Enter and restores the original on Esc; /theme list still prints the names. Refs #12985 fixed in #12999.
  • When the context is over the compaction threshold with nothing to fold, a notice now says what holds the tokens, by class and largest items. Refs #13013.
  • Local stdio MCP servers now receive the extra folders you allowed tools to write in _meta["io.reasonix/writableRoots"]; remote ones do not. Refs #13053.
  • First-run setup gains "Not now": open the workbench first, with a note above the input box leading back to setup; this launch only, offered again next time. Refs #13065 fixed in #13084.
  • The bottom "Generation speed" detail gains "Time to first token" (request sent to first output, timed by the kernel) and now uses the same row layout as the context detail. Refs #13075 fixed in #13089.
  • Adding a project now selects it and opens a new session in it (nothing is sent for you), whether through "Open or create project", the first-run prompt or a folder drop. Refs #13076 fixed in #13088.
  • New floating "Back to top" / "Jump to latest" buttons in the conversation (hidden near an end or when nothing scrolls) land on the nearest expanded block first. Refs #13077 fixed in #13091.
  • The Versions page can switch a release's notes between Chinese and English, following the interface language by default; every release's notes now carry English. Refs #13081.

Changed

  • The Files button in the rail and sidebar now toggles: pressed while the files panel is open it folds it, and it reopens after the panel was closed elsewhere. Refs #12925 fixed in #12997.
  • The composer's model menu now sets provider headings apart, indents the models, and adds multi-select provider chips that are remembered. Refs #12926.

items.html:
CLI archives built from the Studio release studio-v2.39.0.

Changes in 2.39.0

This release adds double-click rename for sessions, starting without any model service, a low-disk-space warning and maps and dashboards in extension surfaces, and tidies the sidebar and conversation display.

New

  • Double-click a session row in the sidebar to rename it in place; the rename dialog can generate a title on request (#12977, #11591 by @Guan0923)
  • Reasonix starts without any model service configured and opens the connection guide directly (#12966)
  • A warning appears when the disk holding a project or session is nearly full; on by default, it only warns and never deletes files (#12960)
  • The terminal UI reports working, waiting-for-you and finished states to the terminal (#12976)
  • A finished session can stay in the Running list for a chosen time; off by default (#12957)
  • The sidebar marks sessions stored by 1.x, and the terminal resume list marks sessions you have not viewed (#12405, #12587)
  • A skill invoked with / shows as a compact skill block, and the JSON input of tool calls is syntax-coloured (#12972, #12969)
  • Files can be staged and unstaged from the changes list (#12923)
  • The application icon shows the count of unread finished tasks, and a new flat icon replaces the old one (#12922, #12897)
  • New "Clear blue" and "Tea green" colour schemes; theme packs can declare density and corner radius (#12932, #12513)
  • The icon rail has a New session button; clicking the folder mark in the title bar opens the project folder (#12891, #12857, #12288 by @keeyangyy)
  • File links in a conversation open in the workbench, and the file menu can add a file or folder to the conversation (#12910, #12877)
  • Remote machines are gathered into one collapsible row, and the levels of the session tree are easier to tell apart (#12878, #12905)
  • Esc must be pressed a second time to stop a running turn (#12859)
  • Extension surfaces support style fields, editable drafts, map-versus-dashboard views and non-blocking actions (#12830, #12854, #12876, #12896)
  • Installed packages can be searched by capability, show their contribution types, copy their invocation, and the install preview shows the resolved commit (#12065, #12117, #12070, #12075, #12098)
  • You can view a sub-agent's skill declarations and search an MCP server's tool list (#12102, #12085)
  • WSL distributions are discovered and one of them is probed (#12595)
  • The phone page can be added to the home screen; paired phones survive a restart, with a switch in settings (#12591, #12440 by @keeyangyy)
  • Linux arm64 .deb and .rpm packages are published (#12914)
  • Local stdio MCP servers receive the working directory and the host's read-only state (#12967)
  • The tool catalogue refreshes automatically when an MCP server adds or removes tools at runtime and sends a notification (#12138 by @boscocp)
  • The host's check of changed turns can be turned off (#12860)
  • Right-to-left text blocks are displayed in their own direction (#12118 by @xxoingr)
  • The workbench browser-tab menu gains "Close browser tabs to the right", reachable by keyboard (#12557 by @SivanCola)

Changed

  • The Versions page keeps only the latest few earlier versions and folds the rest behind a button (#12982)
  • Session lists use single-line ellipsis everywhere, and bulk selection moved to the "This machine" more menu (#12935 by @SivanCola)
  • The desktop sidebar uses divider bars for its actions, and the brand mark is the official wordmark throughout (#12918, #12936)
  • Computer use now runs on the CUA Driver (#12937)
  • The "Execution" block in a conversation is a faint single line, and its header sticks to the top when expanded (#12954, #12944)
  • The session title in the title bar sits next to the project name, and the branch button's hover shape matches its neighbours (#12955, #12971)
  • The model list keeps only the settings page's own scrollbar, and the display-alias input follows the theme (#12979)
  • Installed skills are grouped by source (#12329 by @KHG420)

Fixed

  • Folded user messages no longer vanish entirely when compaction cannot get a summary (#12963)
  • The context-usage figure now uses the same number the compaction trigger uses, instead of reading lower than the provider reports (#12991, #12988)
  • On Windows, clicking a task-completed notification brings the window to the front, and the click path is logged (#12907, #12956)
  • Closing a browser tab no longer reads content the kernel never sends (#12886)
  • A question you have started answering no longer times out and is skipped (#12884 by @par73e)
  • A turn in progress is kept when the runtime is rebuilt or a turn-end event is lost (#11735 by @jf200s)
  • Saving settings now reports success, not applied, and failure separately, and a failure can be retried (#12350 by @KHG420)
  • The undo entry is restored from the backend, and an expired-undo state is kept (#11589 by @Guan0923)
  • Unsaved file drafts in the workbench are kept (#12898 by @XTLine)
  • Context usage refreshes immediately after switching model settings (#12871 by @xlyy1)
  • Cost is shown in the wallet's currency, and the folder picker can list hidden folders (#12874)
  • On Windows, when the Git Bash probe hangs it is retried once, and the fallback shell path is shown correctly (#12887)
  • When only /skill-name is sent, history records exactly what you typed (#12890)
  • Duplicate MCP tool names are refused, and the original identifier stays the same on every path (#12889, #12893, #12892)
  • Sub-agent status frames are no longer lost when the client falls behind (#12888)
  • File preview checks that the target may be accessed, and passes through the PreToolUse hook first (#12115 by @Guan0923)
  • A failed memory save is rolled back, and a migrated memory repairs its index when changed again (#12938, #12939, #12940)

The Studio release page lists the same changes in Chinese and English: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases/tag/studio-v2.39.0

新增

  • 可以查看子代理的技能声明，并搜索 MCP 服务器的工具清单 (#12102 by @KHG420, #12085 by @KHG420)
  • 发现 WSL 发行版并探测其中一个 (#12595)
  • 手机页可以添加到主屏幕；已配对的手机在重启后保留，设置里有开关 (#12591, #12440 by @keeyangyy)

  • 桌面侧栏统一用分隔条操作；品牌标识统一为正式字标 (#12918 by @SivanCola, #12936 by @SivanCola)
  • 计算机操作改用 CUA Driver (#12937)
  • 对话里的「执行过程」改成淡色一行，展开后的头部会吸在顶部 (#12954, #12944)
  • 标题栏的会话标题紧挨项目名；分支按钮悬停的形状与相邻按钮一致 (#12955, #12971)
  • 模型列表只留设置页的一条滚动条，显示别名输入框跟随主题 (#12979)
  • 已安装的技能按来源分组 (#12329 by @KHG420)

  • 压缩拿不到摘要时，被折叠的用户消息不再整段消失 (#12963)
  • 上下文占用的显示改为和触发压缩时用的数字一致，不再比服务商回报的偏小 (#12991, #12988 fixed in #12991)
  • Windows 上点任务完成通知会把窗口带到前台，点击过程写入日志 (#12907, #12956)
  • 关闭浏览器标签时不再读取内核不会发送的内容 (#12886)
  • 你已经开始作答的提问不再超时跳过 (#12884 by @par73e)
  • 运行时重建或回合结束事件丢失后，仍保留正在进行的回合 (#11735 by @jf200s)
  • 保存设置的结果区分成功、未应用和失败，失败后可以重试 (#12350 by @KHG420)
  • 撤销入口从后端恢复，撤销失效状态会保存下来 (#11589 by @Guan0923)
  • 工作台里未保存的文件草稿会被保留 (#12898 by @XTLine)
  • 切换模型设置后上下文占用立即刷新 (#12871 by @xlyy1)
  • 费用按钱包的币种显示，文件夹选择器能列出隐藏文件夹 (#12874)
  • Windows 上 Git Bash 探测挂起时重试一次，并正确显示回退用的终端路径 (#12887)

  • 文件预览会先检查目标是否允许访问，并先经过 PreToolUse 钩子 (#12115 by @Guan0923)
  • 记忆保存失败时会撤回，迁移过的记忆再次修改时会修复索引 (#12938 by @chuiwenwei, #12939 by @chuiwenwei, #12940 by @chuiwenwei)

新增

  • 可以从任意一条回复分支出一个独立的新会话 (#12770)
  • 会话行上有快速归档和删除；可以多选本地会话做批量操作 (#12775, #12807)
  • 把文件夹拖到侧边栏即可添加为项目，项目右键菜单可以打开项目操作 (#12776, #12324 by @KHG420)
  • 从上下文环和检查器就能压缩上下文 (#12777)
  • 对话导航旁显示当前计划 (#12803)
  • 浏览器面板新增宽屏模式，打开时仍能看到对话；浏览器页面可以逐个或批量关闭 (#11762, #12806)
  • 文件面板右键增加「复制路径」和「复制引用」，名称里含冒号或以反斜杠结尾而无法表示成引用时会禁用后者 (#12818, #12842 by @XTLine)
  • 可以给每个模型设置显示别名；添加来源前可以批量检测模型 (#12821, #12835)
  • 模型偏好里可以设置联网搜索使用的模型 (#11761)
  • MCP 服务器的工具定义变更后，需要重新批准才会启用 (#12829)
  • 回退之后对话顶部显示持久的撤销提示，可以关闭，重载后仍在 (#12831, #12559 by @XTLine)
  • 可以在右键菜单里引用选中的回复文字 (#12836)
  • 发送快捷键成为统一的偏好设置 (#12837)
  • 反馈表单里可以直接打开日志文件夹；反馈对话折叠显示并保留未读状态 (#12768, #12802)
  • 正在使用的版本被撤回时，应用会告知用户 (#12769)
  • 工作台「+」按钮会显示启动器，从导航打开聚焦会话的文件 (#12826 by @XTLine, #12832)

变更

  • 会话标签页改为按需开启 (#12841)
  • 项目里置顶的会话排在最前并带标记 (#12845)
  • 默认浅色主题的层次重新调整；视图标签与页面色调一致 (#12793, #12782)
  • 对话壁纸下的文字光晕可以配置 (#12839)
  • 当前使用的模型在输入框的选择器里排第一 (#12801)
  • 手机窄屏上未输入时的输入框更紧凑，并保留分支标识 (#12800, #12813)
  • 左侧图标栏的图标与对应设置分区一致；设置页打开时侧边栏开关仍可用 (#12753, #12798)
  • 首屏改用 1.9 MB 的核心字体子集；对话导航条每个可区分位置只画一个标记 (#12766, #12767)
  • 多个会话共用一个工作区时，写入改用乐观租约 (#12772)
  • 没有声明检查的项目里，写过文件的未识别命令不再免除验证 (#12848 by @boscocp)

修复

  • 长对话里拖选文字会卡死：选区经过的远处块改为按对话原文保留，1200 轮对话里跨屏选择从数十秒降到约 0.1 秒；这些中间块复制出的是对话原文，不再带界面标签 (#12850)
  • 一个超过 128 个字符的 MCP 工具名会让整个会话的每次请求失败：现在只缩短工具名部分 (#12849)
  • 密集的时间线信号可以逐个查看 (#12815)
  • 压缩对话时转录区不再跳动 (#12783)
  • 停放的浏览器页面再次显示时会重新附着，不再留下空白 (#12778)
  • Windows 上替换插件目录时不再重命名被监视的目录 (#11822)
  • 反馈里正确报告 Windows 11 的产品线 (#12734 by @jf200s)
  • 没有任何对话的文件夹现在返回空的会话列表 (#12744 by @jipeng6036-del)
  • 终端界面里补全菜单中按 Esc 会同时停止正在运行的回合 (#12761 by @xxoingr)
  • 记忆改名时先下线旧名再发布；归档记忆恢复失败后可以重试，索引与归档保持一致 (#12785 by @chuiwenwei, #12816 by @chuiwenwei, #12819 by @chuiwenwei)
  • 自动召回的记忆在轨迹里记录是被条数还是字符预算截掉的 (#12843 by @thehui13)

items.html:
本版加入常用服务预设库和主题包删除，并修复严格网关回放无参数工具调用时的 HTTP 400、卡住的外壳探测拖住内核等问题。

新增

  • 添加模型服务时可以从内核维护的常用预设开始：可搜索、按域名分组，选中后整条预设（模型目录、识图模型、窗口、思考档）原样写入，名称重复由内核判断 (#12645)
  • 外观里可以删除已安装的主题包，需要点两次确认，内置主题没有删除入口 (#12623)

变更

  • 删除模型服务时会说明哪些角色改用了其他服务、哪些被清空，并从 provider_access 里去掉该服务 (#12589)
  • 带密钥的供应商请求（聊天、探测、余额、决策协议）不再跟随跨主机的重定向；被拒时说明被重定向到了哪里，聊天也不再重试十次。如果你的中转站会重定向，把 base URL 改成它重定向到的地址即可 (#12570)
  • 每天的第一个回合会告诉模型当天日期，只放在回合末尾，不改变缓存前缀 (#12598)
  • reasonix upgrade 遇到由 npm 或 Homebrew 安装的程序，会提示用对应的包管理器升级，不再自己替换文件 (#12578)
  • 检查通过之后才写入的文档不再要求再验证一次；有工具钩子或边车介入时仍然要求验证 (#12560)

修复

  • 严格的网关在回放无参数的工具调用时返回 HTTP 400「arguments must be valid JSON」：空参数现在发送 {}，已保存的会话保持原样 (#12745)
  • 外壳探测整体有时限，一次卡住的探测不再拖住内核，也不会反复重新启动 (#12615)
  • 本地 .mcp.json 等清单有大小上限，安装被拒时会写明具体原因 (#12641)
  • 内部：Windows 更新助手移除、配置迁移合并为一次读取、启动输入显式绑定、测试稳定性 (#12594, #12592, #12555, #12742)

What's Changed

  • fix(providers): keep key-carrying provider requests on the configured origin by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12570
  • fix(readiness): prose written after a passing check owes no second run by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12560
  • feat(providers): report the roles a removal moved or cleared and prune provider_access by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12589
  • feat(control): tell the model the calendar date on the turn tail, once per day by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12598
  • feat(providers): offer the kernel's curated presets when adding a source by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12645
  • fix(sandbox): bound shell discovery as a whole so a stalled lookup cannot hold the kernel handshake by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12615
  • perf(config): run the retired-key migrations over one read of each config by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12592
  • fix(installsource): bound a local .mcp.json and name the cause of a refused install by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12641
  • perf(boot): bind every storage root Build resolves to its stated home by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12555
  • fix(upgrade): leave npm-installed binaries to npm by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12578
  • refactor(update): remove the unused Windows update helper from studio by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12594
  • feat(studio): delete a theme pack from Appearance by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12623
  • fix(provider): replay a tool call with no arguments as an empty object by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12745
  • docs(release): Studio 2.37.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12746
  • fix(e2ebench): fail mutation and differential analysis when source restoration fails by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12562
  • fix(serve): send an empty sessions list for a folder with no conversations by @jipeng6036-del in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

New Contributors

  • @jipeng6036-del made their first contribution in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12744

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.36.0...studio-v2.37.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

items.html:
本版加入提问等待超时、可选提示音、可选的折叠中间过程、每回合运行时长、改动文件条、工作区额外文件夹设置和编辑连接时更改协议，回执卡改为默认隐藏，并修复 1M 窗口每轮 400、存储迁移卡在校验、滚轮抖动、模型切换被后台任务挡住、Linux 与 Windows 更新等问题。

新增

  • 新增可选的提问等待超时（默认关闭）：设置的会话页、[agent] ask_timeout_seconds 或终端 /ask-timeout 开启后，无人回答的提问超时即跳过，并告诉模型这是超时而非你的回答 (#12661)
  • 每个回合结束后显示它运行了多久，重新载入历史后仍能看到；失败或被取消的回合不显示，旧会话也不补造 (#12656)
  • 输入框上方新增改动文件条，显示「N 个文件已更改 +x -y」，点击打开工作台文件列表；默认开启，可在会话设置里关闭，非 git 工作区不显示 (#12668)
  • 外观的行宽新增「整宽，输入框也铺满」，默认不变，需要时自己选；手机宽度不受影响 (#12703)
  • 设置的「工具与权限」里新增「此项目的额外文件夹」：可添加、移除让 agent 额外可写的文件夹，只对本项目生效，拒绝时给出带代码的原因，默认没有；「完全放行」只决定是否询问，不会扩大可写范围 (#12640, #12715)
  • 新增可选的提示音（默认关闭）：设置的通知里打开后，回合结束、等待批准、模型提问和反馈回复时放一声短提示，不依赖系统通知，窗口在后台也会响 (#12702)
  • 新增可选的「折叠中间过程」（默认关闭，[ui] fold_turn_work）：已结束的一轮只留最后一句，中间的工具调用、思考和中间文字收成一行，点开展开，运行中的一轮始终展开 (#12714)
  • 设置的版本页新增「日志与异常退出记录」：显示日志目录和异常退出留下的文件，不上传任何东西 (#12719)
  • 编辑连接时可以更改协议，不必删掉重建；决策来源不显示该选项，已固定请求地址的连接会被拒绝并说明原因 (#12618)
  • 界面字体与代码字体的建议列表大幅扩充，在 Windows 上不再几乎没有可选项 (#12708)
  • 斜杠菜单里的 MCP 提示词会列出它声明的参数，并标明必填或可选，Studio 和终端界面都有 (#12700)
  • 窗口关闭后重新打开，会回到上次的大小、位置和最大化状态 (#12624)
  • 不带任务编号调用 bash_output 时，列出正在运行的后台任务及其开始时间，模型不必自己记任务编号 (#12627)

变更

  • 回执卡默认隐藏：有未验证的改动时只留一行，点击展开；在设置里或 [ui] show_receipt 可恢复显示，终端界面读同一个设置 (#12721)
  • 打开工作台时先出入口页（文件、改动、浏览器），不再替你打开浏览器；标题栏的浏览器按钮仍直达浏览器 (#12648)
  • 侧栏开关只有一个且位置不变，会话项点击有动作，同一模型连续回复只在首条显示头像和名字 (#12647)
  • 运行分析的信号栏说明它是什么、为什么标记不能拖；窄窗口加高缩放下标题栏折成一个按钮，不再互相压住 (#12646, #12616)
  • 宿主拒绝过的调用会在下一轮告诉模型（只回传确定不可重试的几类），被拒说明也不再写「本会话剩余时间」 (#12697)
  • 本机模型的验证超时单独说明「本机服务没有在时限内回答，模型可能仍在加载」，本机等待放宽到 60 秒，远程仍是 20 秒 (#12704)
  • 设置、用量等机器级页面在远程窗格里也绑定本机运行时，被替换的控制器的货币保存会被拒绝 (#12674 by @XTLine)
  • 悬停提示延迟 0.3 秒，键盘聚焦不延迟 (#12707)
  • 只剩后台任务时也可以切换模型、思考档、窗口、服务或恢复会话：任务继续运行并交给新的运行时，不再被「仍有后台任务」挡住；回合进行中仍会被拒绝 (#12622)
  • 计划模式下调用 browser_open 被拒时，说明原因并建议改用 web_fetch (#12678 by @xlyy1)
  • 通知设置的说明改为如实：总开关默认关闭，前台和后台都会提醒，系统提示音由系统决定，没有单独的声音设置 (#12677)
  • 只读代理现在可以搜索能力目录，不再被误报「未知的动态能力操作」 (#12582)
  • 权限规则可以写 system_one、advise、best_of_n 等仅在特定装配下存在的工具，不再保存时被拒或载入时被报失效 (#12565)
  • 安装计划和插件警告里来自软件包的文字统一按显示场景处理：控制字符不再截断整句，隐藏字符不再悄悄被删 (#12630, #12636)
  • MCP 登录判定改为按 401 的 Bearer 质询和凭据情况，不再靠错误文字里有没有「auth」；没有质询的 401 与 403 现在显示为可重试 (#12613)

修复

  • 存储位置迁移不再在「正在校验」处看似卡死：校验按文件汇报进度，迁移期间继续写入的文件会再次复制，仍不稳定则拒绝并保持原样；校验后又被写过的旧目录会保留；目标目录被拒时列出多余条目 (#12740)
  • 向上滚动长对话时不再抽搐或跳到上一条 (#12706)
  • 还没有输出的运行中调用可以展开，写明命令仍在运行、已运行多久和它自带的超时 (#12720)
  • 恢复 Goal 会真的开始追求，对被阻塞的 Goal 回复后恢复追求；被拒绝的提交带通知码，排队的前端不再说「请重发」 (#12655, #12654)
  • 模型显式交回（阻塞或等待用户）后，宿主不再继续续跑；仍在运行的后台任务算看不见的写入者，通过符号链接写入会记录实际写到哪里 (#12651, #12586, #12619)
  • 通用的 400 说明不再说「通常是程序缺陷」，附上服务给出的原因 (#12710)
  • 上下文接近 1M 时每一轮都返回 HTTP 400：补全预留改为随窗口按比例留出，没有错误码的 400 也会折叠上下文后重放，折叠失败时错误里会写明原因 (#12698, Fixes #12694 fixed in #12698)
  • Responses 协议的流在工具调用不完整时不再悄悄丢掉其中一个，而是判为失败重试 (#12558 by @XTLine)
  • 发给 Responses 的图片补上 detail 字段，官方 OpenAI 地址不再拒收；400 或 422 时在服务返回的文字旁显示本机发出的请求形状，便于排查 (#12666, #12667)
  • stdio 的 MCP 服务若对探测不应答又在收到非 initialize 的首条消息时退出，现在改在新进程上握手，不再等到超时报 context deadline exceeded (#12621)
  • 已写入磁盘的改动被扩展的 tool.after 报告为失败后，不再从改动记录里消失，改完代码仍会要求验证 (#12614)
  • 回执判断某个路径是否属于宿主自己的目录时，改在调用发生时判断，并把各种链接（含 Windows 联接点）和 .. 都视为不属于 (#12632)
  • 删除模型服务被拒时，原因显示在删除按钮旁，并同步清掉所有引用该服务的角色，窗口很矮时也看得到 (#12573)
  • 决策协议的来源不再显示「读取可用模型」按钮 (#12568)
  • 关闭右侧边栏后，滚动条不再被拖拽热区盖住，可以直接拖动；各分栏的拖拽条也不再压住相邻滚动条 (#12620)
  • 重写消息的输入框改为占满所在行，不再只有一个窄的文本框 (#12626)
  • 停靠的浏览器栏从窗格顶部开始，不再空出一截 (#12650)
  • 模型思考时输入一行，思考内容不再被拆成两块 (#12673)
  • 在一个窗口里归档或改动会话后，其他窗口的会话列表会跟着刷新 (#12664 by @par73e)
  • 通知里的占位符（文件名、数量、规则）现在统一替换，不再原样显示 {n}、{name} (#12642)
  • 扩展的几类告警分开计数，一类不再吞掉另一类；重建后缺失边车程序的通知不再丢失；同一条构建期通知在重建时只出现一次 (#12669 by @XTLine, #12690, #12581)
  • 模型的推理被长度上限截断而没有正文时，告知是上限所致，不再只说「别只发推理」 (#12625)
  • 被取消的子任务的记录会交给父任务，但不会被当作答案 (#12628)
  • Linux 的 .deb 更新程序现在接受 reasonix-studio 包名，不再在校验后以 package_rejected 拒绝；.deb 的 CI 校验同步加上 (#12662)
  • Windows 更新时以 --updated 启动安装程序，更新后桌面快捷方式和任务栏固定得以保留 (#12675)
  • Windows 点击系统通知会把 Studio 窗口带到前面 (#12699)
  • 反馈表单的系统一栏按构建号显示「Windows 11」，不再只显示 NT 10.0 而被误认为 Windows 10 (#12701)
  • 后台任务完成等由宿主排队的回合，开始时现在会宣告，界面不再看似无事发生 (#12705)
  • 排队的一行被内核判为无法送达后，会从对话记录里撤下，不再一直显示「等待中」，与队列面板一致 (#12713)
  • Linux 托盘菜单只在内容变化时才重建，避免定时替换把打开着的菜单关掉；这是对一个托盘问题的加固，未确认为根因 (#12709)
  • 附件、壁纸、主题包过大时先拒绝再读入内存，不再因几百 MB 的压缩包耗尽内存 (#12711, #12712)
  • 外壳探测遇到卡住的 bash 一分钟内不再重复启动；网络位置（UNC 共享）上的 bash 与 PowerShell 一律不再被用作 shell (#12633, #12635)
  • 自动安装 .mcp.json 被拒时，保留并显示被拒的原因，不再当作没有这个文件 (#12571 by @xxoingr)
  • 内部：会话旁文件每次事务只读一次并缓存已验证的信任对象，后台命令的退出码和信号改为带类型字段，用户消息的附件改为字段而非文本匹配 (#12653, #12638, #12634)
  • 内部：评测统计、持续集成、依赖升级、官网与技能镜像、赞助鸣谢等不影响使用的改动 (#12629, #12631, #12679, #12681, #12686, #12687, #12639, #12649, #12659, #12612)
  • 内部：测试与基线检查修复、评测记录与语料守卫 (#12607, #12718, #12737, #12739, #12494 by @chuiwenwei, #12495 by @chuiwenwei, #12500 by @chuiwenwei)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@XTLine、@xlyy1、@par73e、@xxoingr、@chuiwenwei

What's Changed

  • test(control): make the scoped-cancel inbox test deterministic by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12612
  • fix(responses): reject incomplete Studio tool calls / 拒绝 Studio 不完整工具调用 by @XTLine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12558
  • fix(permissions): treat conditionally registered tools as known to the rule vocabulary by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12565
  • fix(boot): emit build-time notices once per lineage across rebuilds by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12581
  • docs(readme): thank Right Code as a sponsor, listed first by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12639
  • fix(agent): let read-only agents search the capability catalog by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12582
  • fix(providers): offer no model-listing read for a protocol that declares none by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12568
  • fix(providers): show a refused removal beside Delete and clear every role naming the removed service by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12573
  • fix(studio): the rewrite box spans its row instead of a bare textarea's width by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12626
  • fix(readiness): a write that reached disk stays a write when tool.after reports it failed by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12614
  • fix(agent): tell the model when a reasoning-only response was cut off at a limit by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12625
  • feat(plugin): a 401 Bearer challenge carries a typed authentication identity by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12613
  • fix(plugin): send initialize to a fresh child when the discovery probe goes unanswered by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12621
  • fix(sandbox): do not relaunch a bash probe that hung for the same file within a minute by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12633
  • feat(jobs): carry a failed background command's exit code and signal as typed fields by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12638

items.html:
本版加入 Linux 的 rpm 安装包、MCP 工具定义固定与变更扣留、闲置会话自动归档、硬件加速开关和反馈回复通知，并修复信任库无限增长、新会话默认模型被跳过时无提示等问题。

新增

  • 新增 Linux 的 .rpm 安装包（ReasonixStudio-linux-*.rpm），本版是首个含 rpm 的版本；用 minisign 校验，无 GPG 签名；rpm 安装的版本暂不自动更新 (#12608)
  • MCP 工具定义在你批准时被固定：之后有变化或新增的工具会被扣住，不进入模型请求，调用会被明确拒绝，直到用 reasonix mcp trust <名称> --digest <摘要> 批准；桌面端目前只显示通知 (#12597)
  • 设置的外观页新增「图形」：可关闭硬件加速（下次启动生效），并显示当前窗口的绘制方式；窗口无法绘制时，可用环境变量 REASONIX_DISABLE_GPU=1 或参数 --disable-gpu 仅关闭这一次 (#12451)
  • 设置新增可选的闲置会话自动归档（默认关闭，默认 30 天，范围 1 到 3650）；已置顶、正在运行、有待回答事项或有未读完成的会话不会被归档，归档可恢复 (#11535)
  • 反馈的未读角标在应用打开期间自动刷新，窗口不在前台时有新回复会弹出通知；通知设置里新增「反馈有回复时」开关，在总开关打开时默认开启 (#11538)
  • 设置的「关于」页新增「支持项目」入口，含 PayPal 链接以及默认折叠的微信、支付宝收款码 (#11709)

变更

  • 提交接口 POST /submit 只在提交确实被丢弃时返回 409；已受理并立刻结束的回合、排在结束中回合之后的提交现在返回 202 (#12596)
  • 电脑操作返回给模型的应用名和窗口标题现在限长并转义，包含换行或不可见字符的名称不再能伪造快照行 (#12585)
  • 安装 skill 或本地插件时，复制的来源若是指向目录的别名现在可以安装；批准之后来源别名被改指向别处，会被拒绝而不会复制 (#12112 by @KHG420)

修复

  • 信任库 trusted/ 目录不再无限增长：密封记录不再把合同的验收条目复制进每一回合，义务清单改为只存一份并按摘要引用 (#12609, Fixes #12603 fixed in #12609)
  • 新会话的默认模型是决策来源而被跳过时，终端界面和 reasonix run 现在给出「默认模型不可用」的通知，不再静默改用别的模型 (#12605 by @xxoingr)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@KHG420、@xxoingr

What's Changed

  • test(serve): wait for a trace turn to go silent, not for a fixed time by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12599
  • fix(repolint): wire-parity reads embedded structs and extends, declares PermissionRules by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12590
  • perf(gitcmd): skip the driver listing for subcommands that cannot run a driver by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12588
  • fix(computer): bound and escape application names in the snapshot and app list by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12585
  • fix(serve): judge POST /submit by what admission did with it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12596
  • feat(studio): opt-in archiving of conversations inactive for N days by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11535
  • fix(config): report a skipped default on the new-session path too by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12605
  • feat(studio): switch hardware acceleration off and show how the window is drawn by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12451
  • feat(release): build and publish an rpm of Studio for Linux by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12608
  • feat(feedback): refresh the unread badge while open and announce new replies by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11538
  • feat(studio): add a Support entry to Settings > About by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/11709
  • fix(installsource): copy directory root aliases by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12112
  • fix(agent): stop copying the contract's criteria into every sealed bundle by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12609
  • feat(plugin): pin MCP tool definitions at approval and hold changed tools by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12597
  • docs(release): Studio 2.35.0 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12610

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.34.0...studio-v2.35.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux Debian 系从 .deb 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 .rpm 安装（sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 .deb 走自己的包（.rpm 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

items.html:
本版让输入框可以直接切换工作区的本地分支，界面缩放改用统一范围并支持 Ctrl/Cmd +/-/0，电脑操作能判断每一步是否生效，并修复回退冲突、旧版会话导入、模型切换、GLM 思考参数和多处终端界面的问题。

新增

  • 输入框的分支标签读取真实的 git 状态，并可直接把工作区切换到另一个本地分支；有进行中的回合、后台任务或未提交改动时会明确拒绝并说明原因 (#12092 by @XTLine, #12171 by @XTLine)
  • 界面缩放只有一个声明范围 0.8 到 1.8（步长 0.05），滑块显示的值就是实际保存的值，并可用 Ctrl/Cmd 加 +、-、0 调整 (#12035)
  • 电脑操作的每一步会标明效果是否可信，并带上占住输入的模态对话框；Windows 上输入文字会读回确认，被错误框挡住时不再假装成功 (#12541, #12542)
  • 自动压缩因上次摘要失败而被暂缓时，界面和终端界面会显示一条中英文提示，不再静默 (#12083)
  • 终端界面输入框为空时按回车，回到最新输出并继续跟随，与 1.x 一致；Ctrl+Z 把终端界面挂起到命令行，fg 后恢复 (#12510 by @xxoingr, #12511 by @xxoingr)
  • 思考参数面板按协议声明的字段命名，Responses 协议的服务商不再显示成只支持 Chat (#12498)

变更

  • 侧栏底部的用量、反馈、账号和设置，在图标栏可见时不再重复显示；图标栏隐藏、仅折叠时显示或窄窗口下仍保留 (#12482 by @SivanCola)
  • 显式声明 glm 协议的服务，glm-5.2、glm-5.3、glm-5.3-flash 的请求现在带 reasoning_effort：5.2 选 high 真发 high，选 none 真关思考；5.3 的「关闭」发 thinking=enabled 加 low (#12552)
  • 决策来源不再出现在输入框的模型切换器里，选它会得到明确错误，而不是不可预期的失败 (#12553)
  • 已保存的决策来源点「测试连接」时，改走它自己的协议并给出分类错误，不再提示「加 /v1」 (#12546)
  • 配置编辑锁目录改放在用户主目录下，遇到属于他人的目录时给出明确错误，不再报一个裸的权限错误 (#11374 by @drakeo338)
  • 权限规则写成不对应任何已注册工具的裸命令（如 ask = ["rm"]）时会被报告并拒绝，不再静默失效 (#12536)
  • 安装计划里来自软件包的文字（版本、名称、路径、警告等）现在限长并清除控制字符，.mcp.json 声明的服务数超限会被拒绝 (#12037, #12512 by @xxoingr)

修复

  • 代码回退之后再次回退同一回合或更早的回合，不再误报文件冲突；回退确认里的文件数按整个回退范围统计 (#11572 by @Guan0923, #11692 by @Guan0923)
  • 打开 1.x 会话时不再多出一份同名副本 (#12506)
  • 导入 1.x 目录时，读不了的会话会逐条列出并附带原因，不再只给一个警告数量 (#12538)
  • 模型切换被拒时区分是回合仍在运行还是只剩后台任务，并说明各自的处理办法 (#12505)
  • 模型切换后，已接入的拦截器类扩展不再失效，也不再误报其服务已停止 (#12367 by @KHG420)
  • Windows 上通过注册表里的安装路径找到 Git Bash，回退到 PowerShell 时明确告知；外壳探测有时限且结果会保存，不再拖慢启动 (#12486, #12539)
  • Git 低于 2.31 时，工作区不再被误判为「不是仓库」而丢失状态、提交和分支标签 (#12518)
  • 压缩摘要因输出上限被截断时，自动用加倍的上限重试一次 (#12469)
  • 计划模式拒绝调用时，说明被拒的命令、原因类别和可行的出路 (#12517)
  • 本回合只改了 .md/.rst 文档时，不再被要求运行验证命令 (#12520)
  • 交付卡片不再把主机自己的任务快照、工具缓存和 .git 当作改动，也不再给中文用户显示英文句子 (#12465)
  • 后台任务完成、终止、失败的提示改为按界面语言显示 (#12476)
  • 提问卡片的自由文字输入框始终可见，运行状态明确写为等待你的回答 (#12540)
  • 图标栏的悬停提示不再被裁掉或被遮住 (#12468)
  • 重写已发送消息的输入框与队列行的编辑框随文字长度调整高度，长段落不再只露出两行 (#12477)
  • 记忆页保存时，较新的草稿不会被先前的保存完成而清掉，各条记忆的写入按钮分别保持禁用 (#12135 by @KHG420)

items.html:
本版把图标栏移到窗口最左侧并加入反馈入口与三档显示方式，新增模型选择器搜索与分组、HTML 文件页面预览和「视觉效果」节能档，补齐终端界面的多个按键，并修复队列编辑、回退重发、反馈截图和带天空主题包长时间占用显卡的问题。

新增

  • 图标栏移到窗口最左边，底部新增带未读角标的「发送反馈」入口；外观页「图标栏」改为始终显示（默认）／仅侧栏折叠时显示／从不显示，立即生效 (#12428)
  • 输入框的模型选择器带搜索框（输入即过滤，回车选第一项，Esc 关闭），按服务商分组并固定显示分组标题，条目改为单行，当前模型保留勾选，声明可读图的模型带「读图」标记 (#12442)
  • 工作台文件浏览器里打开 .html/.htm 文件时，标签页新增「预览」视图（默认）：按网页打开，同目录的样式、脚本、图片照常加载，文件变化后自动刷新，未保存的草稿不会被覆盖 (#12443)
  • 设置的外观页「高级外观」新增「视觉效果」：完整（默认）／节能。节能档去掉磨砂玻璃、动态天空和颗粒，布局不变；只作用于本机，立即生效 (#12448)
  • 终端界面的工具审批和计划审批卡片支持用 j/k 和 Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P 移动光标 (#12419 by @xxoingr)
  • 终端界面的提问卡片支持 j/k 上下移动、h/l 在问题之间左右切换 (#12420 by @xxoingr)
  • 终端界面的 /mcp 面板支持 l/右方向键进入服务的工具列表，h/左方向键返回或关闭面板，q 直接关闭 (#12421 by @xxoingr)
  • 终端界面在开启应用内鼠标捕获时，没有选中文字的右键会粘贴剪贴板里的文字，与 1.x 一致，通过 SSH 连接时仍显示原有提示；输入框隐藏时不粘贴 (#12436 by @xxoingr)
  • 终端界面在回合运行中按 Ctrl+Enter，把输入框内容作为引导发送，效果与 Ctrl+S 相同，在下一个工具边界送达；空闲时按它不做任何事，不会把想换行的草稿提交出去 (#12437 by @xxoingr)

变更

  • 打开会话窗格时，MCP、改动、上下文和队列不再在状态返回前后各读取一次；在测试夹具里这四项各由两次降为一次，实际耗时变化尚未实测 (#12344 by @KHG420)
  • Go 工具链升到 1.26.9、网络库 golang.org/x/net 升到 v0.60.0，清除漏洞扫描对本程序报告的 11 项可达漏洞，扫描结果为 0；只影响构建，没有源码改动 (#12446)

修复

  • 带天空的主题包不再让显卡持续满载：天空画布降到每秒 15 帧，窗口不可见或失焦时停绘，面板模糊改为更实的底色。RTX 3060 上空闲占用从 9.3% 降到 1.0%，集成显卡未实测 (#12448)
  • 连续点击队列里两条的「编辑」时，先点的那条较晚返回，不再覆盖后点那条的编辑框和未保存的草稿；较早的拒绝提示也不再盖掉已打开的编辑框 (#12411 by @KHG420)
  • 编辑已发送的消息并重发时，如果回退失败，编辑框保留修改的文字并在原处显示错误，可直接重试，不再关闭编辑框后什么都没发出去 (#12426 by @KHG420)
  • 反馈截图还在读取时提交反馈再点「再写一条」，上一条的截图不再混进下一条反馈 (#12423 by @KHG420)
  • 打开反馈对话框后，焦点偶尔停在标签页上而不进入正文输入框的问题已修复 (#12439)
  • 已发送消息里粘贴或上传并保存的图片现在显示预览；图片读取失败时保留预览框并显示「图片不可用」，竖图不再撑出预览框 (#12332 by @KHG420)
  • 标题栏的设备面板在云端访问离线时，会区分说明是未登录、中继不可达还是中继拒绝，不再一律显示为未登录 (#12429 by @icebear02)
  • 终端界面输入框里调出了多行历史条目后，上下键可以继续往更早的条目翻，不再卡在该条目的第一行 (#12435 by @xxoingr)
  • 项目里声明的 MCP 服务启用后，若命令、参数、环境变量或网址被改动，会回到「待授权」并显示将要启动的命令；升级后已启用的项目服务会再询问一次 (e2d8eba20, GHSA-j7r7-jh9q-wrq2)

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@xxoingr、@KHG420、@icebear02

What's Changed

  • feat(studio): icon rail at the far left, with feedback and three display modes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12428
  • docs(readme): say what Reasonix does in plain words by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12424
  • fix(studio): preserve message edits when rewind fails by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12426
  • perf(studio): avoid duplicate reads before the session is known by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12344
  • docs: UI-change section in the PR template and a 1.x parity table by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12432
  • fix(studio): keep the latest queued edit selection by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12411
  • fix(studio): keep pending screenshots within their feedback draft by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12423
  • fix(tui): j/k and Ctrl+N/Ctrl+P move the approval cursor by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12419
  • fix(tui): j/k and h/l drive the question card by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12420
  • chore(deps-dev): bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.2 in /workers/crash-report by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12408
  • chore(deps): bump tinypool and vitest in /workers/crash-report by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12409
  • fix(tui): q, h/l and Left/Right in the MCP manager by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12421
  • test(studio): wait for the pane's subscription before emitting into it by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12438
  • fix(studio): move focus into the feedback body after the environment has committed by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12439
  • fix(studio): explain why Internet device access is unavailable by @icebear02 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12429
  • fix(studio): preview saved image attachments in user messages by @KHG420 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12332
  • fix(tui): history recall walks past a multi-line entry by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12435
  • fix(tui): right-click with no selection pastes clipboard text by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12436
  • fix(tui): Ctrl+Enter steers a running turn by @xxoingr in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12437
  • feat(studio): group, search and mark the composer model picker by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12442
  • feat(studio): open an HTML file from the explorer as a page preview by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12443
  • test(mcp): make the enable-binding tests hold on Linux by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12454
  • refactor(tui): bring onKey back under the complexity budget by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12447
  • chore(deps): bump Go toolchain to 1.26.9 and x/net to v0.60.0 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12446
  • perf(studio): stop a sky pack and frosted panels from keeping the GPU busy by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12448
  • fix(feedback-sync): count only stable studio tags and merged closing PRs by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12450
  • docs(release): Studio 2.33.0 release notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12456

New Contributors

Full Changelog: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.32.0...studio-v2.33.0

macOS 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。Windows 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。Linux 从 .deb 安装。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 走自己的包，Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.12.6
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog Added Added the prompt-cache-persistent catalog axis (isPromptCachePersistent) for providers whose own endpoint never expires prompt caches; logged-in OpenAI Codex declares it Changed Updated the bundled Yolo-Auto catalog to its current…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added the prompt-cache-persistent catalog axis (isPromptCachePersistent) for providers whose own endpoint never expires prompt caches; logged-in OpenAI Codex declares it
Changed
  • Updated the bundled Yolo-Auto catalog to its current models, qwen3.8-27b (now the default), yolo, yolo-small, and yolo-128k, and removed the retired deepseek-flash-v4 and qwen3.8-flash

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added the _session/steering ACP extension (advertised as _meta.steering.supported), so clients such as agent-shell can steer a running turn; a steer sent while a permission dialog is open cancels that dialog, and _meta.steering.queue: "followUp" queues a follow-up instead (#15885 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth <name> now works over ACP, RPC, and print mode (omp -p '/mcp reauth <name>'): it opens the browser, prints the authorization URL, reconnects the server in the running session, and print mode exits 1 when reauthorization fails (#16046 by @marcintustin)
Changed
  • ACP session/cancel now also cancels prompts that are queued or still dispatching, and stops autonomous runs, instead of being ignored when no client turn is streaming (#15885 by @marcintustin)
  • Idle compaction no longer runs on logged-in OpenAI Codex accounts, whose prompt cache never expires; compacting while idle only threw away a warm cache
  • ACP sessions no longer fail to start when a client-declared MCP server cannot connect; the failure is reported in the session, and an HTTP/SSE server can be repaired with /mcp reauth (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth, /mcp test, and /mcp unauth now pick the project entry when a server is defined in both project and user config, and skip project config when mcp.enableProjectConfig is off (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • /mcp reauth removes the server's stale Authorization header from its config when it writes the new OAuth binding (#16046 by @marcintustin)
  • omp -p '/compact', /handoff, and /retry given as CLI arguments now run the command instead of sending the text to the model, and exit 1 when the command fails; slash text arriving on stdin or from @file is still sent to the model (#16387 by @marcintustin)
  • Interactive startup no longer waits for extensions that register only tools, commands, flags, renderers, or event hooks (for example MCP bridge plugins): they load once the composer accepts input, and your first message waits for them instead. An extension is deferred only after one launch has confirmed it registers no providers, shortcuts, composer shapes, or file fallbacks. Launches that resume a session, pass --tools, or pass flags omp does not recognize still load every extension first (#16684 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed subagents whose role has an explicitly empty fallback chain falling back through the default chain when the default role uses the same model, including after a retry fallback, prewalk or context promotion briefly switched models or the subagent was revived (#16548 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed /usage and omp usage --json listing identity-less OAuth accounts such as Devin as missing usage beside their working reports (#16549 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed releasing or reaping a browser tab returning while Chromium still listed the page; the close now waits until Chromium reports the tab destroyed (#16680 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed the advisor prompt forbidding all repeated advice, including real escalations: advisors may now re-raise a prior nit or concern as a blocker once new evidence makes it one (#13887, #16484 by @pjh890321)
  • Fixed Esc no longer interrupting in the TUI after a second MCP OAuth login replaced an unfinished first one (#16046 by @marcintustin)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Changed
  • In Tern, centered sheets (/context, reports, keyboard shortcuts, BTW history, session info, the pause screen) fill the pane when it is narrower than 100 columns instead of floating with margins (#16676 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed the /agents and /models hubs in Tern squeezing the left sidebar as long lines (such as a streaming new-agent draft) widen the body pane

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added
  • Added RpcConnection.requestCancellable() and Client.requestPermission(params, { signal }); client connections abort a handler and answer -32800 when the peer sends $/cancel_request, while agent connections keep running the request and return its real result (#15885 by @marcintustin)

What's Changed

  • fix(coding-agent): clarify blocker escalation in advisor prompt by @pjh890321 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484
  • feat(coding-agent): support ACP _session/steering for mid-turn client steering by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885
  • feat(acp): support /mcp reauth outside the TUI by @marcintustin in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16046
  • feat(tui): fill narrow Tern panes with centered sheets and pickers by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16676
  • fix(coding-agent): confirm browser tab close and repair red CI tests by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16680
  • perf(coding-agent): load startup-safe extensions after the composer accepts input by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16684
  • fix(coding-agent): keep explicitly empty subagent fallback chains empty by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16548
  • fix(coding-agent): stop listing identity-less OAuth accounts as missing usage by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16549

New Contributors

  • @pjh890321 made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16484
  • @marcintustin made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15885

Full Changelog: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.12.5...v18.12.6

items.title: Oh My Pi v18.12.5
items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: cacheRetention: "long" now requests prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h" (instead of the ignored legacy prompt_cache_retention: "24h"), and promptCache.ttl accepts "12h"…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: cacheRetention: "long" now requests prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h" (instead of the ignored legacy prompt_cache_retention: "24h"), and promptCache.ttl accepts "12h"
Fixed
  • Fixed every OpenAI Codex request failing with HTTP 404 {"detail":"Not Found"} on personal ChatGPT accounts whose token is not region-pinned (#16493)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed
  • Fixed Moonshot kimi-k3 pricing cache writes at $0; usage cost now includes cache writes at Moonshot's $3/M 5-minute rate (#16508)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • providers.cacheRetention: long now keeps OpenAI GPT-5.6+ prompt caches for 12 hours (Responses API; cache writes cost 2.5× input instead of 1.25×)
Fixed
  • Fixed subagents spawning at a caller-supplied effort (e.g. hi → max) while task.enableEffort is off; the field is now ignored and the agent's configured thinking level (including :auto) applies (#16402)
  • Fixed omp update --check failing against JFrog Artifactory registries that add empty dist-tags to a tagged manifest; the update check now uses the registry's curated latest version (#16375)
  • Fixed <path>:conflicts on a file past the 10 MiB scan cap reporting no conflicts with no hint: it now names the line the scan stopped at and the ranged read that registers the blocks after it (#16269)
  • Fixed the ts-set-map rule stalling tool-call streaming for seconds on a long single-line Map literal, and missing Map entries written ["key", value] as const (#16242)
  • Fixed the ts-import-type rule missing inline type imports whose member name is non-ASCII, such as import("./units").温度 (#16242)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Fixed
  • Fixed a macOS background action leaving its target in front of your app after you clicked another of your windows, when placing the click took longer than the click itself (#16217)

What's Changed

  • fix(update): handled empty Artifactory dist-tags on tagged manifests by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16379
  • fix(task): ignored caller effort while task.enableEffort is off by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16406
  • fix(catalog): stopped declaring no_constraint codex residency by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16501
  • fix(catalog): priced moonshot kimi-k3 cache writes at the 5min rate by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16529

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Fixed Enabled native compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy) @oh-my-pi/pi-ai Added Added opt-in reclaimAbovePct to auth.accountPolicies: sessions automatically moved to a lower-priority account…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Fixed
  • Enabled native compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added opt-in reclaimAbovePct to auth.accountPolicies: sessions automatically moved to a lower-priority account return to the preferred one once it has that much quota left (#14237 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added reachesBudgetedHost(): whether the catalog's host request budgets (inline image bytes, official image count) apply to a request, true on a model's official endpoint and on Factory Droid's own hosts (#16288 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Inception API-key login (/login inception) and INCEPTION_API_KEY environment authentication (#16439 by @eggpeat)
  • Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally (#15471 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • isSurvivingAssistant in providers/transform-messages: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside transformMessages pick the same latest turn (#15791 by @will-bogusz)
  • Broker account-pool files (OMP_AUTH_BROKER_ACCOUNT_POOL_FILE) can hide whole providers and API keys: "*": false makes the file an allow-list, and an entry can be true, false, or { "accounts": [...], "apiKeys": false } (#14235 by @will-bogusz)
Changed
  • cursorRawReadPath() writes a bare start line as raw:N- (file:10 → file:raw:10-), so Cursor exec reads of such a path still read from line N onward now that read takes N:raw as one line (#16438 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock logging one warning per dropped thinking block (hundreds for one request) after a conversation change; the drop now logs one warning with the count (#16392 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Core models (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek and others) dropping calls to tools with names over 64 characters and their results from later requests; such names now shorten to 64 characters, and shorter names are sent unchanged (#16384 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Devin /usage showing no data for accounts signed in with /login devin, and Devin chat sending a failing extra auth request for legacy Windsurf Enterprise keys (#13677 by @will-bogusz)
  • Turns stopped for a thinking loop now keep the tokens and cost the provider had reported, the response id, the request's start time, and its time to first token and duration, instead of recording zero usage and no timing (#16437 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Claude requests answering a turn whose attachment is a video, PDF, HEIC or other format sent outside a JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP image as if nothing were attached; the turn now fails with an error naming the format (#16407 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the repeated-tool-call guard missing a loop the model interleaves with a wait that elapses with nothing new; a wait that returns finished work still ends the repetition (#11874 by @dickyudhandika)
  • Fixed Google Antigravity chat and image requests failing with false 429 quota-exhausted errors (#11849 by @jotafurtado)
  • Fixed the stream loop guard never stopping a model stuck repeating punctuation or symbols (?!?!, ✓✓✓) until the output limit; such runs now trip once they repeat for 1 KB, while digit and whitespace runs such as padding and hexdumps are left alone (#14436 by @F0Rextasy)
  • Fixed native remote compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models without changing ordinary Converse turns; a custom non-AWS baseUrl needs remoteCompaction.enabled: true (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Fixed Anthropic compaction blocks dropping their signed tool_changes, which made the replayed block fail its signature (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Added
  • Added native Inception support with Mercury 3, Mercury 2.5, and Mercury 2, live chat-model discovery, API-key login, reasoning controls, and Mercury 3 launch pricing while its catalog reports none; Mercury 3 waits up to 10 minutes for its first output, since high-effort reasoning streams nothing (#16439 by @eggpeat)
Changed
  • Changed Devin model discovery to send legacy Windsurf Enterprise keys unprefixed in one request, dropping the Windsurf-editor retry that returned a smaller model list (#13677 by @will-bogusz)
Fixed
  • Factory Droid now carries Droid's 3.5 MB inline-image budget (inline-image-byte-budget) for its hosted routes, under their 4.5 MB request limit, and the new request-body-byte-limit axis (resolveRequestBodyByteLimit) records that limit; it applies on Factory's own hosts through pi-ai's reachesBudgetedHost (#16288 by @will-bogusz)
  • DeepSeek V4.1 Flash images are now priced by DeepSeek's own billing (994 tokens for a snapcompact frame) instead of a GPT or Claude rate (2,882 to 3,136), so a 25-frame archive no longer counts about 50k tokens the provider never bills and triggers compaction early (#16418 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Amazon Bedrock Kimi K3 (global./us.moonshotai.kimi-k3) offering Anthropic-style thinking budgets it ignores; it now offers low, high and max effort, defaulting to max (#13697 by @alblez)
  • Marked supported Bedrock Claude models as eligible for native compaction (#16343 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • bash tool commands now see PI_SESSION_ID and PI_SESSION_FILE, so a script can find the running session's ID and transcript path (#16442 by @johnrichardrinehart

items.summary: @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core Added AgentTool gained the optional approvalCacheTargets hook, which the always-ask-cached approval mode uses to check and record per-file grants (#16049 by @Peribunt) Changed Tools with lenientArgValidation now receive unknown root…
items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added
  • AgentTool gained the optional approvalCacheTargets hook, which the always-ask-cached approval mode uses to check and record per-file grants (#16049 by @Peribunt)
Changed
  • Tools with lenientArgValidation now receive unknown root arguments that their closed schema would otherwise drop, so they can reject them (#16317)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added validateToolArguments(tool, call, { keepUnknownRootKeys: true }) to keep unknown root keys that a closed schema would otherwise drop during argument repair (#16317)
Fixed
  • Fixed Claude streams that a gateway cut off before message_delta failing the turn instead of being retried (#16341 by @lz-lunzi)
  • Fixed Gemini pairing parallel same-name tool results with the wrong call when history stores them out of call order (sessions from before 18.4.2, SDK-built contexts) (#16259 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Gemini dropping calls to tools with names over 64 characters (most MCP tools) and their results from later requests, so the model called the tool again; such names now shorten to 64 characters (#16283 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed Factory Droid Gemini requests failing with 400 "For schema with items, schema type should be ARRAY" when a tool parameter accepts a string or a list, as the default task tool's model field does (#16249 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed PI_REQ_DEBUG=1 request dumps writing your API key, bearer token and response cookies to disk in plain text: credential headers now read [redacted], as in rejected-request dumps (#16293 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed finalized signed reasoning disappearing from displayed thinking when no deltas streamed (#16227)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • MiniMax MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (the launch id) now gets the always-on low–max thinking the bundled MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview rows have, and omits sampling params (temperature, top_p, top_k) it rejects (#16315 by @SaladDay)
Fixed
  • Gemma 4 models on Google AI Studio (google/gemma-4-31b-it, google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it, …) no longer fail every request with Thinking budget is not supported for this model; thinking is now toggled with thinkingLevel (on = high, off = minimal) (#16350)

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added the Ask and remember approval mode (tools.approvalMode: always-ask-cached, --approval-mode always-ask-cached): it also asks before file reads, and file prompts can remember the folder or the file, for this session or across sessions, through approval-cache.db (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Added /forget-approvals to forget every file and folder approval Ask and remember has recorded (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Extension ui.approve() hosts can render the new prompt.grants choices and answer { grant, always }; hosts that ignore them keep answering once/session/deny (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Extension and custom tools can declare approvalCacheTargets to take part in Ask and remember grants (#16049 by @Peribunt)
  • Added proc://<id>/streams for bash jobs: it lists the command's pipes, and proc://<id>/streams/<n> shows what has crossed pipe n so far, so cmd | tail -5 can be followed live without rerunning cmd
  • Background job widgets are designed per job by the new widget model role (resolves like smol until you assign it): one request writes rules that read the job's output and its pipes (cmd | tail included), and every later update is computed locally with no further model calls or messages to the agent; a subagent gets a widget only once it says which output shows its progress, and a job with nothing worth charting gets none; turn them off with async.widgets: false
  • Running subagents now show their current step, in their own words, on the task card; the periodic completion check also asks the subagent which output shows its progress, so the job widget knows what to chart
  • The wait card shows the watched jobs as a row of tiles, each with its status, name (a subagent's in full), what it is doing, and its headline figure and live widget when it has one (a throughput chart with its target line, per-model bars, CI job status, trial progress), and a subagent's own completion estimate as a ring that turns from blue to green as it fills (hover the tile for the percentage); the HUD jobs pill shows the freshest job's headline and a mini chart, and hovering it opens a card with the running jobs as tiles; the jobs sheet shows the selected job's widget above its output, and the terminal status line appends the headline to the jobs count
Changed
  • While a subagent is focused, /model, /switch, /effort, Alt+P, Ctrl+P, and Shift+Tab change that subagent's model and thinking level (session-only) instead of telling you to return to the main session; /model and Alt+M open the session-only picker there, since role assignments configure the main session
Fixed
  • Fixed omp skill list omitting skills from a skills.customDirectories entry that starts with ~; such an entry now resolves against your home directory, matching the skill loader (#16347 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed grep treating a ;-separated list of internal URLs (e.g. artifact://44;artifact://43) as one URI and refusing to search it; every listed resource is now searched (#14091)
  • Fixed grep refusing a web URL that carries a :raw (or :conflicts) selector before the page was fetched; the selector now reaches the fetch, so :raw searches the verbatim response body (#14092)
  • Fixed browser role/<role>[name="…" exact] selectors in Chromium and Tern tabs matching nothing for many names copied from observe(); a button or link with visible text is no longer matched by its title (#16252 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed /tan clones with Mnemopi auto-recall re-sending the parent's recalled memories as an extra system-prompt block, which duplicated them and missed the parent's prompt cache (#16337)
  • Fixed legacy pi extensions that import contentText from pi-ai or formatSkillsForPrompt

items.html:
@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed
  • The failed-tool-call correction sent to DeepSeek models now also covers chat-template tool-call tokens written out as text, not only malformed DSML (#16216 by @H4vC)
Fixed
  • Fixed Ollama chat history estimates counting stripped native thinking and missing foreign thinking replayed as text, which skewed compaction after model switches (#16164)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added
  • Added nativeJudgmentImageBounds(): the image bounds a native judge enforces, its wire's transport limits tightened by the catalog's model bounds
  • Added Box judgment questions (BoxQuestion/BoxAnswer, TypeSafe Jev 1.14+ direct or through OpenRouter): each names the request image it searches by image index, and comes back as that image's edges as 0–1 fractions; text, OpenAI Decisions, and Workers AI judges reject them
Fixed
  • Fixed Muse Code usage going stale whenever its 5-hour window sits idle: the idle window now reports as unused, and weekly usage carries over from the last active window until its reset (#16193 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed DeepSeek tool calls never running when the model writes them as chat-template tokens with _ in place of ▁, a missing ｜, or no per-call close (e.g. <｜tool_calls_begin｜>…<｜tool_calls_end｜>): they now run as tool calls, and any that still cannot be parsed are removed from history and reported to the model as a failed call (#16216 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Fixed
  • Fixed a relay tab close failing when Chrome refuses it for a moment (a tab being dragged); the extension retries it (#16119 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed tabs created for a relay request whose connection dropped mid-create staying open, and answers to such requests going to a later connection (#16119)
  • Fixed the relay resolving an old tab id to a different tab after a browser restart; the extension now reports each browser run (#16119)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed
  • Seeded TypeSafe jev-1.14.0 and OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.14, and made them the judge role defaults and TypeSafe's default model; TypeSafe discovery keeps seeded ids its alias-only /v1/models listing omits

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added
  • Added computer.backgroundFallback (takeover by default, or refuse): when a computer window input call has no background route, the tool reruns that one call in takeover, hands focus back to your app and says so in its result; refuse fails the call instead and also refuses the agent's own foreground requests (takeover: true, raise(), an activating apps.open, desktop input, and on macOS menus and AXOpen) (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DeepSeek as a web search engine (web/deepseek), using DeepSeek's new Search API with your existing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or stored deepseek credential
  • Added el.selectText(text, { prefix?, suffix?, select? }) to the macOS computer tool: it selects text (or places a caret) in a background app's text field without taking focus, moving the pointer or sending keys, so typing into that field replaces it (#15175 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added { takeover: true } to computer-use win.move, so a hover that a window refuses in the background can be retried in the foreground (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added a menu option to the computer tool's win.click, el.click, el.press and el.perform, so on macOS the call that opens a menu also chooses its item, e.g. menu: ["Add to", "Fonts"] (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added el.type(text) and el.press(chord) to the computer tool, which send text and keys to that element instead of wherever its window's focus is; on macOS and Windows nothing is sent when the element cannot be addressed without taking your focus (#15563 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added: pressing Escape during takeover input now stops computer use for the rest of the turn, and that session's later computer calls are refused, unsent, until your next message (#15564 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added the computer tool's UserIntervened error on macOS: input into an app you have used since the agent last read its window fails without sending, and the agent is told to read the window again and keep your edits (#15562 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added tui.completeScrollback: rows a growing HUD or dialog pushes off screen go straight to scrollback instead of missing from it until it shrinks (#15692 by @Ilm-Alan)
Changed
  • The computer tool and its errors no longer tell the model to retry with takeover: true, and its instructions tell it never to call raise() or apps.open(…, { activate: true }) to make input work (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use window input with takeover omitted now stays in the background after computer.control.acquire, so an acquired grant no longer activates the target app or moves the user's pointer; pass takeover: true for foreground input (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Pressing Escape in your own app no longer stops the computer tool's background window input unless task control is held; Escape in omp still interrupts it, and physical Escape still stops takeover input (#15176 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Box questions to ChainJudge: they go only to Jev judges that answer them, and the box edges measure the image you passed even when it was padded to fit Jev's size bounds
  • A relay browser.open without app.target now opens its own background tab instead of adopting the visible one (after reinstalling the relay extension; older ones select it), and browser.close closes it; app.target still borrows an existing tab (#16119 by @nnnnoel and @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use win.menu.items now needs exec approval and is rejected in read_only runs, since on macOS it makes the window key in its own application before reading its menus (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
